youtube_description:
Welcome to the Neon Gradient Sprint—an AI competition visualization where forecasting models race to predict the next hour of microclimates using streaming satellite + ground sensor data. Watch accuracy, latency, and uncertainty scores climb across the course, as we introduce sensor dropout and storm-like data shifts.

In this episode:
• Compete: 6 specialized ML competitors (Transformer, Graph ML, State-Space, Hybrid Ensemble, Uncertainty AI, TinyML)
• Track the live scoreboard: error vs speed vs robustness
• See how uncertainty impacts decision-making under noise

If you enjoy futuristic ML race visuals, like, subscribe, and comment your winner prediction!
